objective: Convert the Project Owner's clarification into a full-cohort, real-data Park MVP acceptance contract. Replace arbitrary sample-count milestones with one pinned, complete user-workflow dataset package.

previous_knowledge_consumed.detail: The product must be tested as a user would operate it on a coherent real dataset; arbitrary 50/100/1000 object counts are not product acceptance.
DR24 HATS application integration and end-to-end API/Workbench execution remain open.
OID, catalog entry, canonical object, detection, observation, event, dataset and analysis must remain distinct; ambiguous identities must remain explicit.
DR24 HATS is the primary time-series source; ALeRCE and BTS have distinct label/reference roles; Zubercal is supplementary.
Original frozen v0.2.0 production model artifact remains unavailable/unauthenticated in accessible remote sources.

change.completed: Added a full-cohort Park MVP end-to-end acceptance plan. It defines one immutable dataset package with DR24 observations, separate ALeRCE reference labels, BTS independent transient labels, and AOIC identity/provenance. It defines the normal API/Workbench user journey, hard acceptance gates, and READY / READY WITH LIMITATIONS / NOT READY decision rules.
change.scope: Documentation-only research branch change. No application code, model, data, taxonomy, baseline, thresholds or production records changed.
change.rationale: Small deterministic samples are useful for narrow diagnostics only. They cannot demonstrate product readiness, population performance or a complete user workflow. The acceptance run must process the complete predeclared cohort; batching is allowed only if all batches are processed and reconciled.

correctness.before: Existing parallel plan described separate DR24, StarEmbed, BTS and CPVS workstreams but did not define one complete Park user-workflow dataset package.
correctness.after: A versioned acceptance contract now specifies the dataset layers, user journey and gate criteria. No runtime product behavior has yet been measured.

reproducibility.before: No full-cohort Park dataset manifest or repeated application run exists in this change.
reproducibility.after: The new contract requires pinned releases, complete cohort definition, hashes and a repeated full-cohort run.

scientific_validity.reason: This change is a planning contract only. It does not execute DR24 ingestion, model inference or independent BTS evaluation.

measurement.trade_off: A complete cohort makes the acceptance result representative of the declared dataset, but requires explicit accounting for unavailable records, ambiguous identities and source-specific data semantics.

evidence: No code tests or source-backed dataset jobs are claimed for this documentation-only change.

unresolved: The full authoritative BTS release and exact cohort query must be pinned before runtime execution.
The original v0.2.0 production model artifact must be recovered and authenticated.
DR24 feature parity and ordinary API/Workbench integration are not yet demonstrated.
AOIC remains an architecture proposal, not a completed identity service.

knowledge_carried_forward: Do not use arbitrary object counts as product completion criteria.
Use the complete source-defined cohort in the pinned Park Pilot Dataset package.
Keep DR24, ALeRCE, BTS and Zubercal data semantics and taxonomies separate.
Do not run frozen model inference on DR24 until model authentication and feature parity pass.
Keep CPVS as separate research and do not let it block the Park product workflow.
The new acceptance contract is not evidence that the MVP is ready.
expected_improvement: Define one immutable, source-pinned Park Pilot dataset package with a complete eligible cohort.
Specify the normal API and Workbench workflow from dataset selection through reproducible export.
Keep DR24 observations, ALeRCE reference labels, BTS spectroscopic labels and AOIC identity provenance distinct.
Preserve the v0.2.0 baseline and require independent authentication before using its production model.

findings: A planning contract is not evidence of runtime product behavior or scientific acceptance.
The complete source-defined cohort, not an arbitrary object count, is the Park MVP product acceptance target.
DR24, ALeRCE, BTS and Zubercal have distinct source roles and data semantics.
The original v0.2.0 production model must be authenticated before inference; the lab-smoke artifact is not a substitute.
The demonstrator may expose acquisition, light curves, descriptive QC and reproducible exports while classification remains blocked.

open_blockers: Run fresh CI on the amended PR head and inspect all failed or skipped jobs.
Pin the complete eligible Park Pilot cohort and its source releases, query, schemas and hashes.
Complete DR24 application integration and full-cohort Workbench execution.
Authenticate the original v0.2.0 model or separately validate a new Park Pilot model.
Complete AOIC identity/provenance and independent BTS evaluation for supported transient classes.
